baseEntries.title: Wearing a garment
baseEntries.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
baseEntries.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadhath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
baseEntries.translation: Praise belongs to Allah, who clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any might or power of my own.
baseEntries.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 4023 (graded hasan); Sahih Muslim 2097
baseEntries.virtue: Whoever says this on putting on a garment is forgiven their past sins.
baseEntries.instruction: This supplication is for putting on a garment, whether new or previously worn. When putting on shoes, begin with the right foot; when taking them off, begin with the left. The shoe guidance is an action, not words to recite.

daily_wearing_new_clothes.instruction: When putting on shoes, begin with the right foot; when taking them off, begin with the left (Sahih Muslim 2097).

daily_wearing_clothes.virtue: من قالها عند لبس الثوب غُفر له ما تقدّم من ذنبه.
daily_wearing_clothes.instruction: هذا الدعاء عند لبس الثوب، سواء أكان جديدًا أم سبق لبسه. وعند لبس النعل ابدأ بالقدم اليمنى، وعند خلعه ابدأ باليسرى. وهذه إرشادات للعمل وليست ذكرًا يُتلى.

daily_wearing_new_clothes.instruction: عند لبس النعل ابدأ بالقدم اليمنى، وعند خلعه ابدأ باليسرى (صحيح مسلم ٢٠٩٧).

daily_wearing_clothes.translation: Segala puji bagi Allah yang telah memberiku pakaian ini dan menganugerahkannya kepadaku tanpa daya dan kekuatan dariku.
daily_wearing_clothes.virtue: Siapa yang mengucapkannya ketika mengenakan pakaian, diampuni dosa-dosanya yang telah lalu.
daily_wearing_clothes.instruction: Doa ini dibaca ketika mengenakan pakaian, baik baru maupun yang pernah dipakai. Ketika memakai alas kaki, dahulukan kaki kanan; ketika melepasnya, dahulukan kaki kiri. Petunjuk tentang alas kaki merupakan tindakan, bukan bacaan doa.

daily_wearing_new_clothes.instruction: Ketika memakai alas kaki, dahulukan kaki kanan; ketika melepasnya, dahulukan kaki kiri (Sahih Muslim 2097).

sources.supports: Garment supplication. Displayed grading: hasan without the addition 'and later sins'. Virtue deliberately promises forgiveness of past sins only.
Right foot first when putting on shoes; left foot first when taking shoes off.
Hisn al-Muslim's separate general garment-wearing section, distinct from new clothes.
